about: The games on the homepage and the profile page. .github/scripts/games.py writes the homepage's game cards from this file, and CI checks both pages match it.

games.name: Sleazeburg 64
games.summary: Top-down crime satire for the browser, done as if it ran on a C64: 320×200, 16 colours, sprites and SID-style sound. The car radio plays real .sid tunes.

games.name: Sleazeburg 64 for the C64
games.summary: Work in progress: the same city on a real Commodore 64, written in 6502 assembly. So far, smooth scrolling and a car to drive. Plays in the browser in VirtualC64 Web, or on the real machine.
